title: Two more ways to chat
summary:
Four community projects joined the lists, spanning multilingual chat, image generation, and creative tools.

Island AI and Botzy AI joined the Chat Projects list. Island AI combines multimodal chat, web search, and clarifying questions; Botzy AI offers chat in Urdu, English, and Roman Urdu.

Visiora joined the Vibe Coding project list with text-to-image generation, Flux, Turbo, and Kontext options, plus dimension and seed controls.

The open-source aitoolbox.software collection joined Creative Projects, bringing together AI-powered productivity and creativity tools.
